blurb: Glastonbury Marina provides comprehensive boating services including maintenance, docking, and all-season storage. Guests can rent houseboats for a relaxing stay on the Connecticut River with scenic views. The marina also hosts community events and offers amenities like a clubhouse, picnic areas, and showers.
